description: Compile a submitted transform and run it on imported measurement data.
ground_truth_reason: All seven EA-role labels are false: this is ordinary measurement transforms software, not an evolutionary algorithm. The source performs measurement transforms only; no candidate population, candidate fitness pipeline, or offspring/replacement lifecycle exists. Caller-provided or file-provided code is loaded and executed dynamically. Policy basis: The existing decision policy treats dynamic-execution primitives as UNSAFE.
